title: LiteLLM Town Hall on December 3: Product + Roadmap Updates
summary: Join the LiteLLM town hall on Thursday, 3 December at 7:30 AM PT for product, stability and security updates, and open Q&A with the team.
body_markdown:
We are hosting our next town hall on **Thursday, 3 December at 7:30 AM PT** .


## Agenda​


- Product
- Stability
- Security
- Open Q&A with the LiteLLM team


## Stability​


Our team is focused on stability: improving reliability and reducing regressions across releases. Follow the roadmap here:[Stability roadmap](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/issues/30484) .


## How to contribute​


Add the topics and questions you'd like us to cover when you register below. We use your responses to set the agenda.


## Register​


Register here:[LiteLLM Town Hall Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScDOu3EEE3r9KJRsTFKGMK-xloRqA6ZXZ0hdO7JtXFjSmk8_A/viewform)


We will hold the town hall from **7:30 AM to 8:30 AM PT on Zoom** .


For security, attendance is restricted to corporate emails. If you register with a non-corporate email, we will share the town hall slides and accompanying blog post after the event.
